name: Shandris Feathermoon
summary: At Feathermoon Stronghold on Sardor Isle, Shandris Feathermoon commands night elf forces across Kalimdor. For ten thousand years, she has served as Tyrande Whisperwind's right hand.

sections.title: Tyrande's Right Hand
sections.body: For ten thousand years, Shandris Feathermoon has stood beside Tyrande Whisperwind as her right hand among the Sentinels. She is one of the night elves' oldest defenders, serving through the long vigil that followed the Sundering.

sections.title: Rise of the Sentinels
sections.body: After the Great Sundering, the Sentinels were founded. Shandris became an indispensable commander in the night elf military.

sections.title: The Bastion of Feralas
sections.body: From Sardor Isle, General Shandris Feathermoon commands the Sentinel army in the field and oversees Feathermoon Stronghold. The elven fortress watches over Feralas's primal wilds. From the island outpost, she monitors savage gnolls, lingering Gordunni ogres, hate-fueled satyrs, and the Horde's growing power in southern Kalimdor.

aliases: who is the night elf general in feralas
faq.answer: Shandris Feathermoon commands the Sentinel army, the night elves' standing military force. For ten thousand years, she has served as High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind's right hand and led the Sentinels from Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

faq.q: Where can Shandris Feathermoon be found?
faq.answer: Shandris commands from Feathermoon Stronghold on Sardor Isle, off Feralas's western coast in southern Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is Shandris's relationship to Tyrande Whisperwind?
faq.answer: For ten thousand years, Shandris has served Tyrande Whisperwind as her right hand among the Sentinels. Tyrande leads the night elves from Darnassus, while Shandris commands the Sentinel army in the field from Feathermoon Stronghold.

faq.q: Did Shandris fight against the Burning Legion?
faq.answer: The histories told here record no battle against the Burning Legion. Shandris has served beside Tyrande Whisperwind among the Sentinels for ten thousand years and now commands the army from Feathermoon Stronghold.

faq.q: Why is she stationed in Feralas instead of Teldrassil?
faq.answer: As General of the Sentinels, Shandris directs frontline military operations across Kalimdor. Feathermoon Stronghold is the Alliance's primary staging ground and bulwark in the wild southern forests, watching hostile ogres, satyrs, and Horde activity.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, you can look to General Feathermoon as a model of Sentinel discipline and duty. She has guarded your people since the long vigil began.
As a hunter, you can look to Shandris as one of the Sentinels' finest marksmen. She has watched over the night elves for ten thousand years.
As an Alliance soldier in southern Kalimdor, you can rely on General Feathermoon for naval presence, strategic leadership, and a fortified sanctuary on Sardor Isle.
As a member of the Horde, you face General Feathermoon, a dangerous and cunning tactician. Her fortress off the Feralas coast threatens your expansion in the region.
